events.name: StatCardLoaded

overridableConfigKeys.label: Action
overridableConfigKeys.description: Action button

overridableConfigKeys.label: Active Filters
overridableConfigKeys.description: Active filters

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-busy
overridableConfigKeys.description: This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-current
overridableConfigKeys.description: Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-describedby
overridableConfigKeys.description: Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-expanded
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether the element it controls is expanded.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-hidden
overridableConfigKeys.description: Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-labelledby
overridableConfigKeys.description: Id of the element whose text names this one.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-live
overridableConfigKeys.description: Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-pressed
overridableConfigKeys.description: Toggle-button state.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-selected
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Class Name
overridableConfigKeys.description: Additional CSS classes

overridableConfigKeys.label: Compact
overridableConfigKeys.description: Compact display mode

overridableConfigKeys.label: Current Value
overridableConfigKeys.description: Current value as number for trend calculation

overridableConfigKeys.label: Dir
overridableConfigKeys.description: Text direction of this element's content.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter
overridableConfigKeys.description: How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter Delay
overridableConfigKeys.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Error
overridableConfigKeys.description: Error state (UiError)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Icon
overridableConfigKeys.description: Icon to display (Lucide component or icon name string)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Icon Bg
overridableConfigKeys.description: Icon background color

overridableConfigKeys.label: Icon Color
overridableConfigKeys.description: Icon color

overridableConfigKeys.label: Invert Trend
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether up is good (green) or bad (red)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Is Loading
overridableConfigKeys.description: Loading state indicator

overridableConfigKeys.label: Label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Main label

overridableConfigKeys.label: Lang
overridableConfigKeys.description: Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Metrics
overridableConfigKeys.description: Metrics to display (schema format) - accepts readonly for compatibility with generated const arrays

overridableConfigKeys.label: Page
overridableConfigKeys.description: Current page number

overridableConfigKeys.label: Page Size
overridableConfigKeys.description: Number of items per page

overridableConfigKeys.label: Previous Value
overridableConfigKeys.description: Previous value for comparison

overridableConfigKeys.label: Role
overridableConfigKeys.description: WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Search Value
overridableConfigKeys.description: Current search query value

overridableConfigKeys.label: Selected Ids
overridableConfigKeys.description: Currently selected item IDs

overridableConfigKeys.label: Fetch its own rows on mount?
overridableConfigKeys.description: true (default) = standalone mount self-populates on INIT. false = a composing atom owns the fetch and routes its loaded event here — suppresses the wrapper's own un-hydrated fetch so it cannot race the composer's.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Skeleton
overridableConfigKeys.description: Skeleton shown while this element's server render is in flight: a shape (`table`, `list`, …), `{ variant, rows?, columns?, fields? }`, or `none`.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sort By
overridableConfigKeys.description: Current sort field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sort Direction
overridableConfigKeys.description: Current sort direction

overridableConfigKeys.label: Sparkline Data
overridableConfigKeys.description: Sparkline data points for an inline trend chart

overridableConfigKeys.label: Subtitle
overridableConfigKeys.description: Subtitle or description

overridableConfigKeys.label: Surface
overridableConfigKeys.description: Content surface: `auto` paints the theme's surface behind this block unless it already sits on one (a card, dialog or another block); `none` opts out.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tab Index
overridableConfigKeys.description: 0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Title
overridableConfigKeys.description: Title (alias for label)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Total Count
overridableConfigKeys.description: Total number of items

overridableConfigKeys.label: Trend
overridableConfigKeys.description: Manual trend percentage (overrides calculation)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Trend Direction
overridableConfigKeys.description: Trend direction (overrides calculation)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Value
overridableConfigKeys.description: Primary value - accepts array from generated code (will use first element or length)
